title: Migrate `celery` to `common.compat`
body:
Replace version-specific conditional imports with common.compat layer. This standardizes compatibility handling across Airflow 2.x and 3.x.

This PR is a part of [57018](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/57018) about provider celery.

closes https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/57067

@@ -58,6 +58,7 @@ requires-python = ">=3.10"

     # The Celery is known to introduce problems when upgraded to a MAJOR version. Airflow Core
     # Uses Celery for CeleryExecutor, and we also know that Kubernetes Python client follows SemVer
